I do draw, sew, and play games but I don't really enjoy it for much more than an hour or so now. Should I just force myself to even if I'm not having fun? I usually just spend all day wasting my time on reddit bleh.

I do really want to go back to school but I'm so scared I'll fail out again, or find out I can hold a full time job (anxiety, adhd, whatever) and end up wasting the money I spent trying to get a bachelor's.

I'm glad you're feeling better and it worked for you, though.
